fresh_context_scope: The auditor received the task specification but no parent-agent scientific conclusions, expected answers, prior semantic-audit contents, or mandatory-checkpoint contents.

role_separation.same_family_limitation: This is same-family role separation. It is an independent fresh-context read and judgment, but it is not an independent-error model and must not be represented as statistically independent corroboration.

method.protocol_basis: ARS re-review hierarchy: roadmap verification_criteria are immutable Level-1 criteria; Phase-1 operationalization may clarify but cannot extend or weaken them. Extra Phase-1 requirements were audited separately and were not permitted to determine scientific verdicts.
steps: Hash and identify every allowlisted input actually read.
Freeze each row's exact roadmap verification_criteria before considering Phase-1 operationalization or the recorded Phase-2A verdict.
Compare Phase-1 fully-addressed language against the immutable criterion and label material extension or weakening and its verdict relevance.
Check patch/apply/evidence-chain integrity, then read the changed blocks in the full revised manuscript and use the base manuscript to distinguish change from preserved global contradictions.
Judge only evidence present in the revised artifact; plans, future obligations, author assertions, and generic promises receive no execution credit.
Compare the independent semantic result with the recorded Phase-2A verdict and assign any residual obligation class.
For Paper 33, aggregate all 13 registered rows and apply ARS B1-B6 decision rules in order.
method.evidence_standard: Semantic satisfaction of every conjunct in the immutable exact criterion, with global-manuscript consistency where the criterion says every, one consolidated, or no unsupported claim.
not_performed: No external literature or novelty search
No manuscript, roadmap, protocol, result, or outcome mutation
